benefit_conditions: To use the Participating Airport Lounge, customer's card must be validated at point of entry by swiping a transaction of a nominal charge.
If customer has exceeded the quota of complimentary airport lounge accesses as per the Product feature the transaction will get declined.
The Primary Card and Add on Card both need to present their individual cards at the time of entry.
All usage of the Participating Airport Lounges under the Program is conditional upon presentation of a valid eligible Card.
Additional charge may occur for meal/food/drink items (especially Alcoholic Drinks) as well as for services like Nap, Massage Service and Spa.
Participating Airport Lounges may reserve the right to enforce a maximum stay policy (usually 2 - 3 hours) to prevent overcrowding.
The offer is not transferable, non-negotiable and cannot be encashed.
HDFC Bank shall not be liable under any circumstances for the services provided at and by the Participating Lounge.

Each Free Night Award (valid for 12 months) can be redeemed for a one-night stay, inclusive of room rate and applicable taxes, at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy® with a redemption level up to 15,000 Marriott Bonvoy® Points
